title: Algorithms for inference and rational process models
summary: From the computational level to algorithms: exact enumeration, rejection sampling, Markov chain Monte Carlo (Gibbs, Metropolis–Hastings), particle filters and variational inference; the sampling hypothesis and resource-rational analysis as ways of turning an inference algorithm into a psychological process model.
